summary: Creative Global Technology Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing director written resolutions proposing a variation of Class B ordinary share rights (increasing votes from 20 to 100 per share and removing dividend rights) alongside a share restructuring that increases authorized capital then reduces par value. The changes require consent from two-thirds of Class B holders or a special resolution. No price, premium, or advisor is mentioned. The filing is a governance reclassification and capital adjustment, not a traditional special situation. The structural changes may affect control dynamics; watch for shareholder objections and any subsequent takeover or activism implications.
